description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Runtime_GetIncludePath, which manages include paths, directory caches, and file resolution for Smarty templates.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_GetIncludePath
classes.description: Class responsible for managing and resolving include paths and files within Smarty templates.

methods.name: isNewIncludePath
methods.description: Checks if the include path has been updated and refreshes directory cache if needed.

methods.name: getIncludePathDirs
methods.description: Returns the list of include path directories.

methods.name: getIncludePath
methods.description: Resolves and returns the full file path from PHP include_path or false if not found.
